text: Thomas got the keys to the new flat in Leeds, moving in sometime next week. His girlfriend Manon is staying in Bristol till the end of the month.
hana's dad back in hospital, chest infection again. she sounded wiped out. text her friday

Kiara and Ravi have split up, which I didn't see coming at all. Eight years. She's keeping the flat in Hackney and he's gone back to his mum's in Croydon for now, at least until the end of the month. Ravi seemed ok-ish when I saw him at the pub, joking about it, but Kiara's not sleeping and has taken a few days off work. Her sister Laila is staying with her this week.
Need to ring Bridget about her mum's funeral — it's on November 4th at St Mary's, 11am.
Haruto Sato made redundant from the agency, last day was Friday. Says he's relieved more than anything. Wants to retrain as a UX designer.
viewing 2 flats sat morning, one on Elm Rd one by the station. take the tape measure
Luis broke his wrist at football Sunday, cast for six weeks. Right hand too so he can't drive. I'm picking him up for the hospital check on Nov 12.

So I was talking to Abebe at lunch and his little girl has had chickenpox all week, poor thing, she's missed the whole of half term basically and now his wife's caught some bug as well, so he's been off work since Tuesday juggling the two of them. He looked shattered honestly. I should drop round some soup or something over the weekend, and maybe check whether he needs anyone to do the nursery run on Monday.
Anjali's moving to Edinburgh in early March for the new job. Flat hunting there over Christmas.
laila nervous about her MRI on 11/3, they're checking her back. wish her luck the night before
Nikhil's grandad passed away on Sunday. Funeral's sometime next week, in Leicester. He was really close to him.
Eva — allergic to cats, lactose intolerant, hates mushrooms. Remember for dinner.
Mia's flat viewing in Manchester was a disaster, damp everywhere. She's going back up on the 28th to see two more.
Eli's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, came through fine. Eli was a wreck all morning.
Message Rohan to see how the move went, he was meant to get the keys Oct 18.

Fatima called. Her brother Yusuf's been made redundant, third round of cuts at the bank. He's got a consultation meeting Thursday 10/23. She's worried about him, he's got the mortgage and two kids under five, and his wife Adaeze is on maternity leave till early March. Fatima thinks he'll be fine long term, he's had recruiters calling, but right now he's not sleeping. I should send him that contact at Gupta & Kim, they were hiring analysts.
Anika's knee surgery got cancelled again, hospital ran out of beds. No new date yet.
Francesca — lives in Lisbon now, works remote for a design studio, vegetarian, obsessed with ceramics.
Ioana's mum diagnosed with diabetes, type 2. Ioana's been reading everything about diet. Mum's first clinic appt is Dec 2.
zoe + dalia moving in together!! end of the month, a 2 bed in Walthamstow. housewarming probably early December

Dimitri's dad died last month. He didn't say much, just that the house sale is dragging and he's flying out to Athens again over the summer to sort his things. Should check in on him sometime next week, he goes quiet when things are bad.

Nikolai's wedding is off. He and Jada broke up in September after nearly five years, and she's moved back to Glasgow to be near her parents. He told me over a pint last night, very matter-of-fact, but then admitted he's barely been eating and has been working stupid hours to avoid going home to the flat. His brother Dimitri is coming down to stay for a few days over the weekend. I need to make sure he's not on his own on what would have been the wedding day, May 14.
Bins Thursday. Cancel the old broadband before the 15th. Book the van for moving day, Nov 22.

Elif's son Aarav has glandular fever, the doctor reckons he'll be off school for at least three weeks, and it's his GCSE year so mocks are early January. She's stressing about him falling behind more than he is, honestly, he's just sleeping eighteen hours a day. Her husband's away with work until the 30th so she's on her own with it. Don't forget to send her that tutor's number.

Talked to Adaeze Adeyemi after church — her husband's mum is in a care home now, in Croydon, and they're visiting every weekend. Adaeze mentioned she'd love a decent travel mug, the one she's got leaks.

Tomás starts at the Barcelona office on January 6th. He's relocating with his partner Luis and their cat Pimienta, flat's sorted already, near the beach in Poblenou. Luis is less keen, he's leaving his mum behind and she's not been well since the summer. Leaving drinks sometime the week before Christmas, I said I'd sort the venue.
thomas said manon has shingles. painful, off work till mid nov. she's cranky apparently lol
Hana — big into bouldering, rock climbs at the Arch most Tuesdays. Wants to do Fontainebleau over the summer.
Kiara texted: the flat in Hove fell through, buyer pulled out. She's devastated, they'd already packed. Call her tonight.
Ravi's mum had a fall last weekend, fractured hip. Surgery went ok on Monday, she's in for at least ten days. Ravi's going up to Derby on Saturday. Ask him how she's doing when he's back.
Note to self: car MOT due Nov 9. Dentist sometime next week, need to book it.
Bridget's been off sick with long covid since the summer. Has a phased return meeting with HR on 11/18. Still really tired most days.
Haruto's moving back to Osaka in early spring to be nearer his parents, his dad's not been well. Sad but makes sense.
Grab Luis a card and some decent coffee — his last day at the firm is Friday, he's been there twelve years and they're letting him go with the restructure. Gutted for him honestly.
Abebe's colleague Mr Tanaka, the one with the bad back, is on physio twice a week now. Abebe says he's struggling with the commute.
Anjali's sister Laila is pregnant, due June 3rd. Anjali's going to be an auntie for the first time and won't stop talking about it.
Nikhil's flat viewing in Canary Wharf on the 30th. He needs to be out of his current place by end of November. Text him that morning.
Eva Nowak. Neighbour at number 14. Two kids, Eli and Mia, and a very loud spaniel called Rolo. Husband works nights at the hospital.
Mia's appendix burst over the weekend!! emergency op Sunday night, she's ok now, home by Thursday hopefully. Eva sounded shaken. Must take something round for the kids.
Eli got dumped by text. Two years together. He's staying at his brother Rohan's for a bit.

rohan says landlord selling up, they've got till end of jan to find somewhere. looking at bristol or maybe bath since his wife Anjali can work from home now. kids would have to change schools though which they're dreading, esp the eldest who's just started year 7. viewing in clifton on 11/9 and another sometime the week after. he asked if I knew any decent letting agents there, I think Zoe used one, ask her

Fatima's grandmother's 90th has been called off, she's had a stroke. In the Royal Free, stable. Fatima's flying back from Dubai on Nov 1st. Send her a message today, then maybe flowers to the hospital once we know visiting is ok.

Voice memo. Okay so Anika and her husband Nikolai, they're finally moving out of London, they found a place in Margate, completion is meant to be December 12th but the chain is a nightmare so could slip to January. She's also started a pottery course on Wednesdays which she loves. And Nikolai's mum is moving in with them for a bit after her hip replacement in early February. Lot going on. I think I should offer to help on moving day, I've got the big car.
Francesca broke up with Tomás. Mutual apparently. She's fine, says she's 'free'.
ioana feeling low, job hunting since she was let go in august. interview at the museum Nov 7 — terrified. good luck msg morning of
Zoe's dad has prostate cancer, early stage. Starts radiotherapy sometime next week. She told me on the walk, held it together really well. Check in with her after the first session.
Dalia — gluten free, coeliac. Into running, doing the Brighton half in April. Hates surprise parties.

Dimitri finally moved into the new place in Peckham on Saturday, after the whole saga with the last landlord. Top floor, no lift, so his back is killing him from carrying the sofa up. Housewarming is November 15, I'm bringing drinks and probably helping set up. His girlfriend Elif has a new kitten, Mochi, who's apparently terrorising the place already.
Jada's gran died this morning. She was 97. Funeral likely end of next week in Kingston. Jada asked if I could do a reading. Need to reply to her today.
Spoke to Elif briefly — Yusuf's start date at the new job is pushed to Dec 1 because of the redundancy notice period. He's relieved it's sorted.
Adaeze's daughter Kiara has tonsillitis again, third time this year. ENT appointment on 11/20, they might take them out. Adaeze is exhausted.
Aarav (goes by Ari) is house-sitting for us Nov 14 to Nov 21. Leave keys and the wifi password. Feed fish.
Tomás's dog Churro went missing on Sunday near the park. Posters up. He's beside himself. Share the post on the neighbourhood group.

Lunch w Thomas. He's properly thinking of leaving London altogether, maybe Sheffield, since his sister Hana lives up there already and rents are half. Hates the commute, hates the flat, and since his dad's heart attack in the spring he wants to be closer to home. Probably not before the summer though because of his contract. Going up to look around sometime in early December.
Manon's flight home is March 2nd, back to Lyon for good. Visa ran out. Leaving do probably late February. Remind me to sort a group present, she's mentioned wanting a proper film camera.
Picked up boxes from the corner shop. Still need tape and bubble wrap. Movers confirmed for the 22nd, 8am.
Kim from upstairs (Ravi Kim) — physio, plays cello in an amateur orchestra, has a gecko called Doug.
Haruto texted at 2am, his mum's surgery went well!! Recovery will take till early January. Call him sometime this weekend, and send something to the house maybe.
Bridget and her husband are off to Lisbon for their anniversary on Nov 8th, first trip since his heart scare in the spring.
Long day. Rang the council about the parking permit for the new address, on hold 40 mins, nothing sorted. Try again Monday morning before 9. Also the meter reading for the old flat.
